item.title: ‘We don’t want to be owned by the US’: Denmark, Greenland push back at Trump
item.description: Denmark and Greenland have confirmed that the United States has agreed to set up a joint working group to explore future cooperation on Greenland, even as all sides acknowledge that tangible progress remains limited for now.

item.title: US and Venezuela signal détente as interim leader vows more prisoner releases
item.description: Venezuela’s acting president Delcy Rodríguez has vowed to continue freeing detainees held under Nicolás Maduro, calling her first post-ouster phone call with US President Donald Trump “positive” — signalling a possible thaw in ties.

item.title: Asian markets slip as tech stocks drag, oil tumbles on Iran signals
item.description: Equities across Asia traded mixed to lower while US futures edged down, with Big Tech losses weighing on sentiment and crude prices sliding after comments by President Donald Trump eased fears of imminent executions in Iran.

item.title: Early turnout nears 7 pc as polling begins for BMC elections in Mumbai
item.description: Mumbai votes in the high-stakes #BMCElections after a four-year gap, with polling underway under heavy security and early turnout showing stark ward-wise contrasts.

item.title: Air India cancels US flights as Iran shuts airspace, delays hit Europe routes
item.description: Air India on Thursday cancelled several long-haul flights to the United States and warned of delays on certain European services after Iran closed its airspace, disrupting westbound operations from India.

item.title: Police book around 500 over vandalism at NH-66 toll plaza in Kerala
item.description: Police in Kerala have registered a case against around 500 unidentified people for allegedly vandalising a toll plaza at Arikady on the NH-66 stretch, following protests against the start of toll collection, officials said on Thursday.

item.title: US funding bill proposes to withhold Pakistan aid over Afridi case
item.description: Draft US funding bill for FY2026 proposes withholding part of aid to Pakistan unless Washington is assured of Dr Shakil Afridi’s release.
